patthana15.40:1.1: Cetasikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacetasiko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.40:2.1: Cetasikaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacetasiko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.40:3.1: Acetasikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naacetasiko naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
